items.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says a tanker caught fire after hitting a mine east of Hormuz.

items.en: A Palestinian man was injured in an Israeli forces' assault near Nablus.

items.en: Tehran submitted its response to Vance's letter amid Qatari efforts to prevent war.
